metadata.display_name: Retrieve Multiple Custom Object Schemas In Batch Request
metadata.description: Retrieve details of multiple custom object schemas by providing a batch request with specified inputs.
metadata.learn_more: Retrieve details of multiple custom object schemas by providing a batch request with specified inputs. This operation allows you to fetch schema information, including properties and associations, for multiple custom objects in a single API call.

includeAssociationDefinitions.label: Include Association Definitions
includeAssociationDefinitions.description: Indicates whether to include association definitions in the response.

includeAuditMetadata.label: Include Audit Metadata
includeAuditMetadata.description: Indicates whether to include audit metadata in the response.

includePropertyDefinitions.label: Include Property Definitions
includePropertyDefinitions.description: Indicates whether to include property definitions in the response.
